description: This is a PHP source file for a service class named PurgeService, which is part of the OrangeHRM HR management system. It handles GDPR-related data purging operations for employees and candidates, utilizing strategies defined in YAML configuration files, and dispatches events after purging. The class manages database transactions, external dependencies, and key methods to purge employee and candidate data.

classes.name: PurgeService
classes.description: Service class for managing GDPR data purge operations for employees and candidates, including transaction management, strategy invocation, and event dispatching.

methods.name: getPurgeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeePictureService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: purgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs GDPR data purge for a specific employee, handling transactions and event dispatching.

methods.name: purgeCandidateData
methods.description: Performs GDPR data purge for candidate data based on vacancy ID, with transaction handling.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Loads and returns purgeable entities configuration from YAML file.

methods.name: getPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a purge strategy object based on class name, strategy, and configuration info.
